strongest_angle: Examine how the Library of Virginia successfully completed its five-year archival preservation effort to digitize 99 historical 'Free Negro Registers' from nearly 60 localities, revealing crucial personal narratives through Virginia Untold: The African American Narrative.

key_facts.fact: The Library of Virginia completed a five-year archival preservation effort to digitize 99 historical Free Negro Registers for the digital project Virginia Untold: The African American Narrative.
The 99 digitized volumes of historic Free Registers originate from nearly 60 Virginia localities across the state.
Lydia Neuroth traveled to Southwest Virginia to continue the work digitizing Free Negro Registers for Virginia Untold from courthouse archives.

named_entities.name: Virginia Untold: The African American Narrative
